quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than a bus in a bus stop, or a taxicab in a taxicab stand, when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed, except that the driver of a passenger vehicle may temporarily stop there and for the purpose of and while actually engaged in expeditiously loading or unloading of passengers when such stopping does not interfere with any bus or taxicab waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

activation.context: officially designated and appropriately signed taxicab stand
activation.subject: operator of a vehicle other than a taxicab

obligation.action: stop, stand or park in that taxicab stand
obligation.source_clause: or a taxicab in a taxicab stand

judgment_calls_needed.note: Activation depends on the actual sign and its applicability.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The passenger exception depends on nearby transit approach and interaction.
